overall_reason: A single hand-written slide with no tokens: the palette is small (cream, tan accent, three browns) but the small text runs in 1px steps from 9 to 15px and hairlines use six alpha recipes for one job.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY passes on the colour count; T-DRIFT-PAIRS fails on small text sizes, border alphas and scrims (TOK-010, TOK-004).

findings.evidence: The slide sets small text at 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 and 15px (values.1920.font_size): the 'AI · GENERATED' corner tag is 9px, the REPLAY button 10px, the panel labels 11px, the chapter line '02B · IN PRACTICE' 13px, the step text 14px and the card names 15px. near_duplicates flags 13/14 and 14/15.
findings.after: Three small steps: a label size (11px), a body size (14px) and one card-name size
findings.why: Viewers cannot see a 1px step, so labels and body lose a clear contrast between them.

findings.evidence: Hairlines use six recipes: tan #d4a574 at 0.18, 0.20 and 0.30 alpha and cream #f5efe6 at 0.06, 0.08 and 0.12 alpha (values.1920.colour_border). The DEFAULT and SKILL · ON pills and the panel rules all do one job: a thin divider.
findings.before: Six border colours for one hairline job
findings.after: Two hairline values: one quiet rule (cream at 0.08) and one accent rule (tan at 0.30)
findings.why: Each panel then picks its own alpha and the dividers read as slightly different weights.

findings.evidence: Fills repeat the pattern: tan at 0.06 and 0.10 alpha, #0a0a0a at 0.70 and 0.90, #000000 at 0.40 and 0.45 (values.1920.colour_fill; 6 of 9 fills are one-offs).
findings.after: One scrim value and one tinted-panel value
findings.why: Two scrims 5% apart do the same job and double the values to keep in step.

strengths: The text palette is five roles (cream ink, tan accent, three browns) and it holds across both panels.
Radii are limited to 1 and 2px, so cards and pills share one sharp-corner decision.
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
T-HARDCODE, T-TOKEN-TIERS: the slide declares no custom properties; its literals are its system
the #slop region (the generated cover shown on purpose) is an exhibit and was not judged
